name: Arwen Moonflower
portraitDescription: Elegant and refined, with pale skin often having a golden or silver hue. Hair is typically blonde, silver, or black. Eyes are often gold, silver, or blue. Wearing natural materials like bark and leaves, carrying a wooden staff, looking wild and connected to nature. The character is exceptionally attractive and a pleasure to look at, with elegant features. Key features: pointed ears, slender build, graceful posture, shimmering robes.
